TopAppBar.description:
Material Design 3 Top app bar.

Surface container, 64dp (small / center) or two-row 112dp (medium) / 152dp
(large). Title uses TitleLarge (small/center), HeadlineSmall (medium) or
HeadlineMedium (large); OnSurface title, OnSurface nav icon,
OnSurfaceVariant actions; 16dp title inset — per Compose AppBar tokens.

props.name: actions
props.description: Trailing action controls.

props.name: navigationIcon
props.description: Leading navigation control (e.g. a back or menu IconButton).

props.name: title
props.description: The bar title.

props.name: variant
props.description: Size / layout.

BottomAppBar.description:
Material Design 3 Bottom app bar.

80dp SurfaceContainer bar hosting action icons (OnSurfaceVariant) at the
start and an optional FAB at the end, per Compose BottomAppBarTokens.

props.name: children
props.description: Action controls (icon buttons).

props.name: floatingActionButton
props.description: Optional trailing floating action button.

props.name: children
props.description: Content the badge is attached to (e.g. an icon).

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value. Values above this show `{max}+`.

props.name: size
props.description: Badge size. `"small"` renders a dot; `"large"` renders a label.

props.name: value
props.description: Number to display inside the badge. Ignored when `size="small"`.

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the badge is visible.

BottomSheet.description:
Material Design 3 Modal bottom sheet.

SurfaceContainerLow container, 28dp top corners, elevation 1, max-width
640dp, an OnSurfaceVariant 32×4 drag handle — per Compose SheetBottomTokens.
Slides up over a 0.32 Scrim; role="dialog" aria-modal, Escape-to-close.

The drag handle is an accessible button (click/Enter dismisses) and the
pointer can drag the sheet down: release past 56px, or a downward fling
faster than 125px/s, dismisses; otherwise the sheet settles back (Compose
ModalBottomSheet thresholds).

props.name: dragHandleLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the drag handle button.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on scrim click, Escape, drag-to-dismiss, or the drag handle.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the sheet is shown.

props.name: showDragHandle
props.description: Show the top drag handle.

Button.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Button.

A native `<button>` — activation, keyboard, and `onClick` are standard DOM
behavior (MUI-idiomatic). The MD3 state layer, press ripple, and focus ring
come from the shared primitives; the corner morphs to a tighter shape while
pressed via CSS `:active` (Expressive). Set `toggle` for a selectable button
(`aria-pressed`); the `text` variant has no toggle styling.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Uncontrolled initial selected state (toggle mode).

props.name: endIcon
props.description: Trailing icon (decorative).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the triggering event and the next selected state when toggled.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selected state (toggle mode).

props.name: shape
props.description: Resting shape; both shapes morph to a tighter corner while pressed.

props.name: size
props.description: Container size on the Expressive scale.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Leading icon (decorative).

props.name: toggle
props.description: Enable toggle (selectable) behavior with `aria-pressed` (Expressive).

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis.

ButtonGroup.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Button group — an invisible container that adds
padding between buttons and modifies their shape.

`standard` spaces buttons by the size's between-space (12dp at sm, per Compose
ButtonGroupSmallTokens) and pops the pressed button. `connected` joins buttons
with a 2dp gap (ConnectedButtonGroupSmallTokens), fully rounding the outer
corners and giving the inner corners a small radius. Wraps `Button` /
`IconButton` children — it has no color of its own.

props.name: children
props.description: `Button` / `IconButton` children.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout direction.

props.name: size
props.description: Controls the between-space to match the child button size.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`standard` spaces buttons and pops the pressed one; `connected` joins them
into a single shape with small inner corners.

Card.description:
Material Design 3 Card.

A container `<div>` with the three MD3 styles (filled / elevated / outlined),
corner-medium (12dp) shape. Passing `onClick` makes the whole card
interactive — it gains `role="button"`, keyboard activation, a hover
elevation bump, the state-layer ripple, and the focus ring.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable interaction and dim the card (only meaningful when `onClick` is set).

props.name: dragged
props.description: Apply the MD3 dragged appearance (raised elevation) — for drag-and-drop.

props.name: variant
props.description: Container style.

Carousel.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Carousel.

A horizontally scroll-snapping row of 28dp-rounded items (16dp side / 8dp
block padding, 8dp between items — per m3.material.io carousel specs). Items
dynamically shrink as they move out of the focus zone at either edge, giving
the M3 "large / medium / small" mask. `multi-browse` snaps items to the start,
`hero` centres a large item with a peek of the next, `uncontained` scrolls
uniform items to the edge.

props.name: children
props.description: `CarouselItem`s.

props.name: itemHeight
props.description: Item height in px.

props.name: itemWidth
props.description: Preferred (large) item width in px.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Gap between items in px.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Layout. `multi-browse` mixes large/medium/small items, `uncontained`
scrolls uniform items to the edge, `hero` centres one large item with a
peek of the next.

Checkbox.description:
Material Design 3 Checkbox.

Uses a native `<input type="checkbox">` for proper form integration and
accessibility. The visual container, checkmark, and state layer are rendered
via CSS on sibling spans. Structure mirrors material-web.

MUI parity: the forwarded `ref` points at the ROOT `<span>`; `inputRef`
reaches the native `<input>`.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled checked state.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Uncontrolled initial checked state.

props.name: error
props.description: Error state.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Indeterminate (mixed) state.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref to the native `<input>` element (the forwarded `ref` points at the root).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the native event and the next checked state on toggle.

Chip.description:
Material Design 3 Chip.

Supports assist, filter, input, and suggestion variants.
Uses a native `<button>` for the primary action. Filter chips toggle
selection. Input chips support a trailing remove button.

Structure mirrors material-web: each action has its own Ripple/FocusRing.
Primary Ripple is scoped to the action button. The trailing remove button
has its own circular 24dp Ripple/FocusRing.

Keyboard: Arrow keys move focus between primary and trailing actions
(matching material-web's multi-action chip pattern). Trailing action is
not in the Tab order; only reachable via arrow keys.

The forwarded `ref` points at the ROOT `<span>` (MUI parity); extra props
(`{...rest}`) still land on the primary action `<button>`.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Uncontrolled initial selected state.

props.name: dragged
props.description: Apply the MD3 dragged appearance (state layer + elevation) — for drag-and-drop.

props.name: elevated
props.description: Whether the chip uses elevated styling (no outline, shadow).

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon.

props.name: label
props.description: Chip label text.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the triggering event and the next selected state (filter chip).

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Fires when the remove button is clicked.

props.name: removable
props.description: Whether a trailing remove button is shown (input / filter removable).

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selected state (filter / input chips).

props.name: showSelectedIcon
props.description: Whether to show a leading checkmark when selected (filter chip).

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant.

DatePicker.description:
Material Design 3 Date picker (modal calendar).

SurfaceContainerHigh panel, 28dp corners, 360dp wide, elevation 3. Day cells
are 40dp round; selected fills Primary / OnPrimary, today shows a 1dp Primary
outline. In `range` mode two dates are picked and the span is highlighted with
SecondaryContainer — per Compose DatePickerModalTokens. Wrap in a `Dialog`
for a full modal experience, or use `DatePickerField` for the docked variant.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale for month / weekday names.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable date (inclusive).

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable date (inclusive).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the new value (`Date` in single mode, `[start, end]` in range).

props.name: range
props.description: Select a start/end range instead of a single date.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value — a `Date` (single) or `[start, end]` (range).

DatePickerField.description:
Material Design 3 Docked date picker.

An outlined text field (type a date directly) with a trailing calendar button
that opens the `DatePicker` in a dropdown — the docked / input variant per
m3.material.io. Closes on selection, outside click, or Escape.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial date.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable date.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable date.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the newly selected/parsed date (or null when cleared).

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected date.

Dialog.description:
Material Design 3 Dialog (basic / alert).

SurfaceContainerHigh container, 28dp corners, elevation 3, 280–560dp wide,
24dp padding; Secondary icon, OnSurface HeadlineSmall title, OnSurfaceVariant
BodyMedium text — per Compose DialogTokens. Modal with a 0.32 Scrim,
role="dialog" aria-modal, and Escape-to-close.

props.name: actions
props.description: Trailing action buttons (typically text Buttons).

props.name: children
props.description: Supporting content / body.

props.name: fullScreen
props.description: Full-screen dialog: a top bar (close + title + action) over full-bleed content.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional hero icon (Secondary, 24dp, centers the title).

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on scrim click or Escape.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is shown.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog headline.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Orientation.

props.name: variant
props.description: Layout variant.

Fab.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Floating Action Button.

A native `<button>` (MUI-idiomatic `onClick`) supporting 4 sizes
(small 40dp, regular 56dp, medium 80dp, large 96dp), 3 color sets
(`primary` / `secondary` / `tertiary`, each tonal by default or
high-emphasis via `tonal={false}`), and an optional label for the Extended
FAB. With `expanded` the Extended FAB morphs
between icon-only and icon + label: the label row's measured width
(`--_label-total`) scales with the spring-driven `--_ext` while the label
cross-fades via `--_label-o` — or, with `followContainer`, both follow a
morphing container's inherited `--_t` instead. Elevation lifts on hover
(level 3 → 4) and the corner morphs while pressed (CSS `:active`).

props.name: color
props.description: Color set for the container/content roles.

props.name: disableElevation
props.description:
Removes the container shadow. Per the MD3 spec a FAB inside a Navigation
rail (or drawer) has no elevation.

props.name: expanded
props.description:
For an Extended FAB (with `label`): `true` shows the label, `false`
collapses it to the plain icon-only FAB. Toggling runs the MD3 Expressive
spring morph (Compose `ExtendedFloatingActionButton(expanded=)`).
Omit for a static Extended FAB. Ignored without `label`, and ignored
while `followContainer` drives the morph.

props.name: followContainer
props.description:
Follows the `--_t` morph value inherited from a morphing container
(e.g. a `NavigationRail` header) instead of running the FAB's own
spring, staying exactly in sync with the container's spring. While
`true`, `expanded` is ignored. Requires `label`.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon displayed in the FAB.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional label — turns the FAB into an Extended FAB.

props.name: size
props.description: Container size.

props.name: tonal
props.description:
`true` (the default) renders the tonal palette — the `*-container` /
`on-*-container` roles (e.g. `primary-container`). `false` renders the
high-emphasis accent palette — the base color roles (e.g. `primary` with
`on-primary` content).

FabMenu.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) FAB menu.

A FAB that opens into a vertical stack of labelled action items anchored to
its top-trailing edge. The FAB morphs into a 56dp close button (container
primaryContainer → primary, icon onPrimaryContainer → onPrimary) and the items
stagger in — per m3.material.io / Compose FloatingActionButtonMenu. Items use
the container/on-container roles of the chosen color set (primary / secondary
/ tertiary). Closes on outside click, Escape, or item selection.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the FAB (closed state).

props.name: children
props.description: `FabMenuItem`s (up to six).

props.name: closeAriaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the close button (open state).

props.name: color
props.description: Color set.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state.

props.name: icon
props.description: FAB icon shown while the menu is closed.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Notified when the open state changes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon (decorative).

IconButton.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Icon Button.

A native `<button>` (MUI-idiomatic `onClick`) supporting the 4 variants, the
Expressive size/width scale, and toggle mode. The state layer, ripple, and
focus ring come from shared primitives. The shape morphs to a tighter corner
while pressed (CSS `:active`) and round⇄square on toggle selection.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Uncontrolled initial selected state (toggle mode).

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon (decorative; the button is labelled via aria-label).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the triggering event and the next selected state when toggled.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selected state (toggle mode).

props.name: selectedAriaLabel
props.description: Accessible label swapped in when selected (toggle mode).

props.name: selectedIcon
props.description: Alternate icon shown while selected in toggle mode.

props.name: shape
props.description: Resting shape; morphs on press and on toggle selection.

props.name: size
props.description: Container size on the Expressive scale.

props.name: toggle
props.description: Enable toggle (selectable) behavior with aria-pressed.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis.

props.name: width
props.description: Container width footprint.

ListItem.description:
Material Design 3 list item.

Auto-sizes to one- (56dp), two- (72dp) or three-line (88dp) based on the
presence of `overline` / `supportingText`. Passing `onClick` makes the row
interactive (role="button", keyboard activation, ripple, focus ring).
Colors follow ListTokens: headline OnSurface / BodyLarge, supporting &
overline OnSurfaceVariant, leading/trailing OnSurfaceVariant.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the item and dim its content to 38%.

props.name: headline
props.description: Primary text (headline).

props.name: leading
props.description: Leading element (icon, avatar, image, control).

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler. Providing it makes the row interactive (role="button").

props.name: overline
props.description: Small label above the headline.

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks the item selected (secondary-container fill).

props.name: supportingText
props.description: Secondary text below the headline.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Trailing element (icon, control, metadata).

props.name: trailingSupportingText
props.description: Trailing metadata text (right-aligned label).

LoadingIndicator.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Loading indicator.

A 48dp indicator whose 38dp active shape morphs through the seven Material
shapes (SoftBurst → Cookie9 → Pentagon → Pill → Sunny → Cookie4 → Oval) while
spinning. The shapes are traced from the official Material 3 Design Kit
vectors; the morph + per-step 90° kick run on a spring (dampingRatio 0.6) over
a linear global rotation, with cadence measured from the m3.material.io
reference. `contained` puts the OnPrimaryContainer shape on a PrimaryContainer
circle; `value` gives the determinate form (Circle → SoftBurst).

props.name: color
props.description: Active shape color (overrides the token default).

props.name: containerColor
props.description: Container fill for the `contained` variant (overrides PrimaryContainer).

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered diameter in px.

props.name: value
props.description: Progress `0..1` for the determinate indicator. Omit for indeterminate.

props.name: variant
props.description: `uncontained` (shape only) or `contained` (shape on a PrimaryContainer circle).

Menu.description:
Material Design 3 Menu (dropdown).

Anchors a `role="menu"` popup to a trigger. SurfaceContainer container, 4dp
corners, elevation 2, 112–280dp wide, 8dp vertical padding — per Compose
MenuTokens. Closes on outside click, Escape, Tab-out, or item selection.

`variant="vertical"` renders the MD3 Expressive vertical menu (Compose
`DropdownMenuPopup`/`DropdownMenuGroup`): a transparent popup that stacks
`MenuGroup` containers (surface-container-low, elevation 2, 2dp gap) with
44dp items, 20dp icons, positional corner shapes, and a tertiary-based
selected state with a springy shape morph. `color="vibrant"` switches the
groups and items to the tertiary-container based high-emphasis mapping.

Keyboard (WAI-ARIA APG menu-button pattern): Enter/Space/ArrowDown open and
focus the first item (ArrowUp: the last); ArrowUp/Down cycle with wrap;
Home/End jump; printable characters move focus by typeahead; Escape and
item activation close and return focus to the trigger. Items use a roving
tabindex (-1) so the closed/open menu never pollutes the page Tab order;
disabled items are focusable but inert (`aria-disabled`).

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal alignment to the trigger.

props.name: children
props.description: `MenuItem`s — or, for the `vertical` variant, `MenuGroup`s.

props.name: color
props.description:
Color option for the `vertical` variant: `'standard'` (surface based) or
`'vibrant'` (tertiary based, higher emphasis).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Notified when the open state should change.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens the menu (a single button-like element).

props.name: variant
props.description:
`'standard'` is the baseline dropdown menu; `'vertical'` is the MD3
Expressive vertical menu (segmented `MenuGroup` containers, 44dp items,
selected states with shape morph).

props.name: endIcon
props.description: Icon at the end of the item (decorative).

props.name: selected
props.description:
Selection state (for the menu's `vertical` variant). When set (even to
`false`) the item becomes a `role="menuitemcheckbox"` with `aria-checked`;
a selected item shows the tertiary-container mapping and morphs to a 12dp
corner shape.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Icon at the start of the item (decorative).

MenuGroup.description:
A visually distinct group of items inside a `variant="vertical"` `Menu`
(Compose `DropdownMenuGroup`): a surface-container-low container at
elevation 2 whose corner shape depends on its position in the menu (single
group 16dp; first 16/8dp, middle 8dp, last 8/16dp), morphing to the 8dp
inactive shape while another group is hovered.

props.name: children
props.description: `MenuItem`s (and `MenuDivider`s).

props.name: label
props.description: Optional section label rendered above the group's items.

NavigationBar.description:
Material Design 3 Navigation bar (bottom).

80dp SurfaceContainer bar of destinations. The active item shows a 56×32
SecondaryContainer pill behind its 24dp icon (OnSecondaryContainer), a
Secondary LabelMedium label; inactive items are OnSurfaceVariant — per
Compose NavigationBarTokens.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial destination value.

props.name: itemLayout
props.description: Item layout: icon over label (`vertical`) or beside it (`horizontal`, flexible).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the triggering event and the newly selected destination value.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected destination value.

props.name: badge
props.description: Badge on the icon: content (e.g. `"3"`) for a large badge, `true` for a small dot.

props.name: icon
props.description: The item icon.

props.name: label
props.description: The item label.

props.name: value
props.description: Identifies the destination; matched against the parent value.

NavigationDrawer.description:
Material Design 3 Navigation drawer (standard or modal).

360dp SurfaceContainerLow (modal) / Surface (standard) panel, rounded 16dp on
the trailing edge. Items are 56dp full pills (CornerFull): active =
SecondaryContainer / OnSecondaryContainer, inactive transparent /
OnSurfaceVariant, LabelLarge — per Compose NavigationDrawerTokens. Modal adds
a 0.32 Scrim, Escape-to-close, and `role="dialog" aria-modal`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the triggering event and the newly selected destination value.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the modal scrim is clicked or Escape is pressed.

props.name: open
props.description: Modal open state.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected destination value (shared with items).

props.name: variant
props.description: Standard (inline) or modal (overlay + scrim).

NavigationRailItem.description:
A destination inside a `NavigationRail`.

The whole row is the (full-width) click target; the active indicator is a
pill that hugs its content — a 56×32 pill around the icon when collapsed,
growing to wrap icon + label when expanded. Layout is a single stable DOM
whose pill, icon and label are absolutely positioned and interpolated from
the inherited `--_t` morph value (0 = collapsed, 1 = expanded), so the tween
driving `--_t` produces a continuous morph with no reflow. The label's
natural width is measured into `--_label-w` so the pill can hug it.

props.name: badge
props.description: Badge on the icon: content (e.g. `"3"`) for a large badge, `true` for a small dot.

props.name: expanded
props.description:
Layout when used standalone (outside a `NavigationRail`): `false` =
collapsed (icon over label), `true` = expanded (icon beside label in a
pill). Toggling runs the same spring morph the rail uses. Inside a
`NavigationRail` this is ignored — the rail's `variant` governs.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected state when used standalone (outside a `NavigationRail`).

props.name: value
props.description: Destination value; selected state is derived from the parent rail.

NavigationRail.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Navigation rail — the Compose
`WideNavigationRail` with `collapsed` / `expanded` variants that morph on a
spring. Collapsed is a 96dp Surface column of icon-over-label destinations
with a 56×32 SecondaryContainer pill on the active item; expanded grows to
220dp and lays each destination out as icon + label in a full-width pill.
The whole transition (width, item spacing, and every item's icon/label/pill)
is interpolated from a single spring value. An optional `header` (menu button,
FAB) is pinned at the top.

props.name: arrangement
props.description: Vertical placement of the destinations below the header.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial destination value.

props.name: header
props.description: Optional header content (e.g. a menu button and/or FAB) pinned at the top.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the triggering event and the newly selected destination value.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected destination value.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`collapsed` (96dp, icon-over-label) or `expanded` (220dp, icon beside label
in a full-width pill). The change is a spring morph.

props.name: shape
props.description: Indicator shape.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the indicator in pixels.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Indicator thickness in dp.

props.name: value
props.description: Progress value from 0 to 1. Omit for indeterminate progress.

props.name: shape
props.description: Indicator shape.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Indicator thickness in dp.

props.name: value
props.description: Progress value from 0 to 1. Omit for indeterminate progress.

Radio.description:
Material Design 3 Radio Button.

Uses a native `<input type="radio">` for proper form integration and
accessibility. The visual outer ring, inner dot, and state layer are rendered
via CSS on sibling spans. Structure mirrors material-web.

MUI parity: the forwarded `ref` points at the ROOT `<span>`; `inputRef`
reaches the native `<input>`.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled checked state.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description:
Uncontrolled initial checked state (native input behavior — the browser
manages group exclusivity for radios sharing a `name`).

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref to the native `<input>` element (the forwarded `ref` points at the root).

props.name: onChange
props.description:
Fires with the native event and this radio's `value` (as a string — the
same value a wrapping `RadioGroup` reports) when the radio is selected.

RadioGroup.description:
Groups `Radio` components: distributes a shared `name`, manages the selected
value (controlled via `value` or uncontrolled via `defaultValue`), and
exposes a `role="radiogroup"` landmark. Label the group with `aria-label` or
`aria-labelledby`. Arrow-key navigation between radios comes from the native
inputs sharing the group name.

props.name: children
props.description: `Radio` elements (any depth).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial selected value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable every radio in the group.

props.name: name
props.description: Shared input name for the group. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the native event and the newly selected value.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected value.

SearchBar.description:
Material Design 3 Search bar (docked field + search view).

56dp SurfaceContainerHigh stadium field; OnSurface BodyLarge input,
OnSurfaceVariant placeholder, OnSurface leading icon — per Compose
SearchBarTokens. Providing `children` (results) turns it into a docked search
view: a dropdown under the input (Outline divider) that opens on focus and
closes on Escape / outside click.

MUI parity: the forwarded `ref` and any extra props (`{...rest}`) land on
the ROOT element (the `role="search"` landmark); input concerns are
dedicated props (`placeholder`, `name`, `onFocus`, `onKeyDown`, …),
`inputRef` reaches the native `<input>`, and `inputProps` spreads extra
attributes on it (the component's own wiring wins).

props.name: children
props.description: Suggestion / result content shown in the open search view.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input and applies disabled styling.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: Icon / control at the end of the bar.

props.name: inputProps
props.description:
Extra attributes spread on the native `<input>` — the escape hatch for
attributes without a dedicated prop (e.g. a distinct `aria-label` for
the searchbox, `maxLength`, `pattern`, extra `aria-*`, …).
Precedence: the component's own wiring always wins over conflicting
`inputProps` keys — the controlled `value` / `onChange` and internal
`onFocus` / `onKeyDown` handling, `type="search"`, `className`, and
every dedicated input prop the component sets (`placeholder`, `name`,
`disabled`, …).

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref to the native `<input>` element (the forwarded `ref` points at the root).

props.name: name
props.description: Native input `name`.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Blur handler for the native input.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the native event and the new query.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Focus handler for the native input.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Key handler for the native input.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Notified when the open state should change.

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Fires when the user submits (Enter).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open (search-view) state.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Native input `placeholder`.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Icon at the start of the bar (defaults to a search glyph).

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled query value.

SegmentedButton.description:
Material Design 3 Segmented Buttons (single- or multi-select).

A 40dp stadium row of outlined segments (Outline 1dp). Selected segments fill
with SecondaryContainer / OnSecondaryContainer and show an 18dp check;
unselected are transparent with OnSurface content — per Compose
OutlinedSegmentedButtonTokens. Segments are toggle buttons (aria-pressed).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial selection. Defaults to none (`''`, or `[]` when `multiSelect`).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the whole group.

props.name: multiSelect
props.description: Allow selecting multiple segments.

props.name: onChange
props.type: ((event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement, MouseEvent>, value: string | string[]) => void)
props.description: Fires with the triggering event and the next selection (string, or string[] when `multiSelect`).

props.name: options
props.description: The segments.

props.name: showSelectedCheck
props.description: Show a check icon on selected segments.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected value (string) — or an array of values when `multiSelect`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial selection. Defaults to none (`''`, or `[]` when `multiSelect`).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the whole group.

props.name: multiSelect
props.description: Allow selecting multiple segments.

props.name: onChange
props.type: ((event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement, MouseEvent>, value: string | string[]) => void)
props.description: Fires with the triggering event and the next selection (string, or string[] when `multiSelect`).

props.name: options
props.description: The segments.

props.name: showSelectedCheck
props.description: Show a check icon on selected segments.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected value (string) — or an array of values when `multiSelect`.

SideSheet.description:
Material Design 3 Side sheet (standard or modal).

A 400dp max-width panel anchored to the trailing (or leading) edge. Standard
= inline Surface panel; modal = SurfaceContainerLow over a 0.32 Scrim with
`role="dialog" aria-modal` and Escape-to-close — per m3.material.io specs.
Header uses 24dp side padding (16dp with a back icon), 12dp gaps, a Title
Large headline, and optional back/close IconButtons. Bottom actions are a
72dp left-aligned bar.

props.name: actions
props.description: Bottom action bar content (left-aligned buttons).

props.name: anchor
props.description: Edge the sheet is anchored to.

props.name: backLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the back button.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the close button.

props.name: headline
props.description: Title shown in the header.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Called when the back button is clicked.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on close-button click, scrim click, or Escape.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the sheet is shown.

props.name: showBackButton
props.description: Show a leading back button (modal).

props.name: showCloseButton
props.description: Show the trailing close button.

props.name: showDivider
props.description: Show a divider between the header and content.

props.name: variant
props.description: Standard (inline) or modal (overlay + scrim).

Slider.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Slider.

Native `<input type="range">`(s) overlaid on MD3 visuals: five sizes (XS–XL,
track 16–96dp / handle 44–108dp), single or **range** (`[start, end]`),
**centered** (active from the midpoint), **vertical** orientation, optional
tick marks, value-indicator bubble, and an **inset icon** in the handle
(md/lg/xl). Handle Primary, active track Primary, inactive SecondaryContainer;
disabled active 38% / inactive 12% — per m3.material.io & Compose SliderTokens.

MUI parity: the forwarded `ref` and `{...rest}` land on the ROOT element;
`inputRef` reaches the first native `<input type="range">`.

props.name: centered
props.description: Draw the active track from the center outward.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: inputRef
props.description:
Ref to the native `<input type="range">` element (the forwarded `ref`
points at the root). A range slider renders two inputs; `inputRef`
reaches the FIRST (start / minimum) one — query its siblings for the end
input if needed.

props.name: insetIcon
props.description: Icon shown inside the handle (sizes md/lg/xl only).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the native event and the new value (same shape as `value`).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Orientation.

props.name: rangeEndLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the end (maximum) thumb of a range slider.

props.name: rangeStartLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the start (minimum) thumb of a range slider.

props.name: showTicks
props.description: Render tick marks at each step.

props.name: showValueLabel
props.description: Show the value-indicator bubble on hover / focus / drag.

props.name: size
props.description: Expressive size (track thickness / handle height).

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value (`number`, or `[start, end]` for range).

props.name: valueLabelFormat
props.description:
Format the value-indicator label. A `string` / `number` result is also
announced via `aria-valuetext` so AT reads what the label shows.

Snackbar.description:
Material Design 3 Snackbar (the visual bar).

Presentational surface — pair it with your own positioning / auto-hide logic.
Colors follow SnackbarTokens: InverseSurface container, InverseOnSurface
message (BodyMedium), InversePrimary action (LabelLarge), corner 4dp,
elevation level 3.

props.name: action
props.description: Optional action — an `{ label, onClick }` button or a custom node.

props.name: message
props.description: The message text (supporting text).

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: When provided, shows a trailing dismiss (close) icon button.

SplitButton.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Split button.

A leading action button joined to a trailing menu button (2dp gap). Both share
the standard button color schemes; the outer corners are round (CornerFull)
and the inner corners small. Opening the menu morphs the trailing button's
inner corner to round and rotates its chevron 180° — the signature split-button
interaction (per m3.material.io split-button specs). Reuses `Menu` for the
dropdown and the shared Ripple / FocusRing primitives.

props.name: children
props.description: Leading action button label.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state.

props.name: menu
props.description: `MenuItem`s shown when the trailing button opens the menu.

props.name: menuAlign
props.description: Menu alignment to the trailing button.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Notified when the menu open state changes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled menu open state.

props.name: size
props.description: Container size on the Expressive scale.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Leading icon (decorative).

props.name: trailingAriaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the trailing menu button.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis (shared by both buttons).

SwipeToDismiss.description:
Material Design 3 Swipe-to-dismiss row.

A pointer-draggable row that dismisses when released past the threshold
(Compose default 56dp), in either direction by default. The dismissed
direction (`startToEnd` / `endToStart`) is reported via `onDismiss`; the
revealed `background` is entirely caller-provided (Compose ships no color).

props.name: background
props.description: Content revealed behind the row while swiping.

props.name: enableEndToStart
props.description: Allow end→start (right→left) dismissal.

props.name: enableStartToEnd
props.description: Allow start→end (left→right) dismissal.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Fires when the row is swiped past the threshold in an enabled direction.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Distance (px) past which release dismisses.

Switch.description:
Material Design 3 Switch.

Uses a native `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">` for proper form
integration and accessibility. The visual track, handle, and icons are
rendered via CSS on sibling spans. Structure mirrors material-web.

MUI parity: the forwarded `ref` points at the ROOT `<span>`; `inputRef`
reaches the native `<input>`.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Uncontrolled initial selected state.

props.name: icons
props.description: Show icons on both states.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref to the native `<input>` element (the forwarded `ref` points at the root).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the native event and the next selected state on toggle.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selected (on) state.

props.name: selectedIcon
props.description: Icon shown when selected.

props.name: unselectedIcon
props.description: Icon shown when unselected.

Tabs.description:
Material Design 3 Tabs (a `role="tablist"` row of `Tab`s).

Primary tabs use a Primary content-width rounded (3dp) indicator with Primary
active content; secondary tabs use a full-width 3dp line with OnSurface active
content. Both sit above an OutlineVariant 1dp divider, per Compose
Primary/SecondaryNavigationTabTokens. Arrow keys move between tabs.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial tab value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the triggering event and the newly selected tab value.

props.name: scrollable
props.description: Scrollable tabs size to content and scroll horizontally instead of filling.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected tab value.

props.name: variant
props.description: Indicator style.

Tab.description: A single tab; must be rendered inside `Tabs`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional icon (shown above the label).

props.name: label
props.description: Tab label.

props.name: value
props.description: Identifies the tab; matched against the parent `Tabs` value.

TextField.description:
Material Design 3 Text field (filled / outlined).

A single-line `<input>` — or auto-growing `<textarea>` with `multiline` —
wrapped in the MD3 field anatomy: floating label (outlined variant notches
the border), start/end icons, prefix/suffix text, and a supporting
line that holds helper text, the error message, and the `maxLength`
counter. Value follows the standard controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or
uncontrolled (`defaultValue`) input pattern; clicking anywhere on the
container focuses the input.

MUI parity: the forwarded `ref` and any extra props (`{...rest}`) land on
the ROOT element; input concerns are dedicated props (`type`, `name`,
`placeholder`, `required`, `readOnly`, `autoComplete`, `maxLength`, …),
`inputRef` reaches the native `<input>` / `<textarea>`, and `inputProps`
spreads extra attributes on it (the component's own wiring wins).

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: Native input `autoComplete`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input and applies disabled styling.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: Icon at the end of the field (decorative).

props.name: error
props.description: Error state — error colors, `aria-invalid`, and `errorText`. Ignored while `disabled`.

props.name: errorText
props.description: Shown instead of `supportingText` (with `role="alert"`) when `error` is set.

props.name: id
props.description: Applied to the native input (keeps the floating label association via `htmlFor`).

props.name: inputProps
props.description:
Extra attributes spread on the native `<input>` (or `<textarea>` when
`multiline`) — the escape hatch for attributes without a dedicated prop
(`pattern`, `min`, `max`, `step`, `onKeyDown`, extra `aria-*`, …).
Precedence: the component's own wiring always wins over conflicting
`inputProps` keys — the controlled `value` / `onChange` / `onFocus` /
`onBlur`, `id`, `className`, and every dedicated input prop the
component sets (`type`, `name`, `placeholder`, `required`, `readOnly`,
`autoComplete`, `maxLength`, `rows`, …).

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref to the native `<input>` / `<textarea>` element (the forwarded `ref` points at the root).

props.name: label
props.description: Floating label; rendered with a trailing `*` when `required`.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Native input `maxLength`; also shows a `length / maxLength` counter in the supporting line.

props.name: multiline
props.description: Render a `<textarea>` that auto-grows with its content.

props.name: name
props.description: Native input `name`.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Blur handler for the input / textarea.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Native change handler for the input / textarea.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Focus handler for the input / textarea.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Native input `placeholder`.

props.name: prefixText
props.description: Static text before the input value (e.g. currency symbol).

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Native input `readOnly`.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the input required and appends `*` to the label.

props.name: rows
props.description: Initial visible rows of the `multiline` textarea.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Icon at the start of the field (decorative).

props.name: suffixText
props.description: Static text after the input value (e.g. unit).

props.name: supportingText
props.description: Helper line below the field. Replaced by `errorText` while in error.

props.name: type
props.description: Native input `type` (single-line only).

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled input value.

props.name: variant
props.description: Container style.

TimePicker.description:
Material Design 3 Time picker (dial + input).

SurfaceContainerHigh surface with hour/minute selector fields (PrimaryContainer
when active), an AM/PM toggle (TertiaryContainer selected), and either a 256dp
SurfaceContainerHighest clock dial with a Primary selector, or editable input
fields — toggled with the keyboard/clock button, per Compose TimePickerTokens.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial value.

props.name: mode
props.description: Initial entry mode: clock `dial` or keyboard `input`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires with the new value.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value.

Toolbar.description:
Material Design 3 (Expressive) Toolbar — a container of action slots.

`docked` renders a full-width 64dp bar (SurfaceContainer / PrimaryContainer),
center-aligned with a 16dp minimum outside padding. `floating` renders a
rounded, elevated pill (CornerFull) with 8dp inner padding and 4dp gaps that
can flow horizontally or vertically — per m3.material.io / Compose
FloatingToolbarTokens. Standard = SurfaceContainer, vibrant = PrimaryContainer.

props.name: children
props.description: Slots — usually icon buttons, buttons, or text fields.

props.name: color
props.description: Color scheme.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Item flow direction (floating only).

props.name: variant
props.description: Docked (full-width bar) or floating (rounded, elevated).

Tooltip.description:
Material Design 3 Tooltip.

Wraps a single trigger element and shows a tooltip on hover / focus.
Plain (InverseSurface, 4dp, BodySmall) or rich (SurfaceContainer, 12dp,
elevation 2, with a subhead and an optional action). Sets `aria-describedby`
on the trigger and `role="tooltip"` on the popup; Escape dismisses.

props.name: action
props.description: Rich tooltip action node (e.g. a text button).

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger element (a single focusable/hoverable element).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial visibility.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Notified when visibility should change.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled visibility.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred placement relative to the trigger.

props.name: subhead
props.description: Rich tooltip subhead (title).

props.name: text
props.description: Body / supporting text.

props.name: variant
props.description: Plain style or rich (with subhead + action).
